run_a2c_experiment: run an A2C reinforcement learning experiment on CartPole-v0 with configurable hyperparameters
create_gym_env: create a single Gym environment by name using gym.make for use in multiprocessing
create_env: create multiple Gym environments wrapped with TimeLimit and return a GymEnv for parallel training
create_agent: create a ReinforceAgent instance with a given model and number of actions
review_Experiment_class: review the Experiment class that extends A2C and initializes with config, create_env, and create_agent
